## 📋 Diagnostic Logs

To attach or inspect AeroSpot log files:
- **Portable Edition:** Open `<AppFolder>\Data\logs\` (`host.log`, `worker.log`, `tools.log`).
- **Installed Edition:** Open `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AeroSpot\logs\`.
- Or click on **Settings** -> **Data Folder** -> **Open Data Folder**.
